title: Heat Kernel Textures: the Geodesic Gaussians That Do Not Splat
abstract: arXiv:2609.07557v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting has recently revolutionised novel view synthesis as well as many other 3D vision methods and applications. Drawing inspiration from this representation, we now rethink textures to overcome the main issues of UV mapping while considerably lowering their memory footprint. Heat Kernel Textures (HKTex) eliminate UV unwrapping as well as their persistent issues of wasted UV space, seams, distortions, vertex-duplication, and varying resolution. Grounded in discrete Riemannian geometry and intrinsically defined on any manifold surface discretised as a triangular mesh, HKTex uses anisotropic heat kernels as geodesic equivalents to Gaussians. Like our kernels, also the optimisation of their position and the adaptive densification strategies were redefined to operate on the surface of the object to be textureised. Our novel representation is also fully integrated with a physically based renderer and can be optimised either

translated_title: 热核纹理：不会溅射的测地高斯
translated_abstract: 三维高斯溅射（3D Gaussian Splatting）近来彻底革新了新视角合成以及许多其他三维视觉方法和应用。受这种表示方法的启发，我们重新思考纹理表示，以克服UV映射的主要问题，同时大幅降低其内存占用。热核纹理消除了UV展开，以及UV映射长期存在的一系列问题，包括UV空间浪费、接缝、畸变、顶点重复和分辨率不一致。HKTex立足于离散黎曼几何，内在地定义在任何被离散化为三角网格的流形曲面上，使用各向异性热核作为高斯的测地等价物。与核函数本身一样，其位置的优化和自适应致密化策略也被重新定义为在待纹理化物体的表面上直接操作。这种新表示还与基于物理的渲染器完全集成，并且可以对其进行优化
tldr: 提出热核纹理（HKTex），一种以各向异性热核作为测地高斯的内在纹理表示方法，可直接在三角网格表面进行优化，彻底消除UV展开带来的空间浪费、接缝、畸变、顶点重复和分辨率不一致等问题，并显著降低内存占用。
en_tdlr: Proposes Heat Kernel Textures (HKTex), an intrinsic texture representation that uses anisotropic heat kernels as geodesic equivalents of Gaussians, optimized directly on mesh surfaces to eliminate UV unwrapping issues such as wasted space, seams, distortions, and inconsistent resolution, while significantly reducing memory footprint.
